note: eFV X2 team revealed-preference columns, development read only: descriptive inputs for EFV_X3, selects and adjudicates nothing

estimator.statistic: within (side, vintage) Spearman, size-weighted, arm minus PROSPX consensus (efv_v2_stat.paired_delta)
estimator.fit: OLS of the training target percentile on [1, consensus percentile, standardized columns], rows with a resolved id; missing value takes the training mean

x2_promos_per_season.text: arrivals at a level above every level reached before, per season with a line

x2_promo_age_rel.text: mean over arrivals of season age minus the median age at that level and season

x2_midseason_jumps.text: levels beyond the first inside a season, per season with a line

x2_skipped_levels.text: full-season levels jumped over at an arrival from a full-season level

x2_add_before_elig.text: 1 when the first 40-man add came before the first eligible Rule 5 draft day

x2_r5_protect.text: +1 on the 40-man, -1 exposed, at the latest eligible Rule 5 draft day; 0 none yet

x2_r5_exposed_n.text: eligible Rule 5 draft days at which he was exposed

x2_r5_selected.text: 1 when taken in the major league phase of a Rule 5 draft

x2_r5m_selected.text: 1 when taken in the minor league phase of a Rule 5 draft

x2_release_events.text: releases, designations for assignment and outrights

x2_trade_principal_mlb.text: 1 when one of at most two players his club sent for a return holding a major leaguer

x2_nri_springs.text: distinct springs on a big-league non-roster invitee list

x2_bonus_vs_slot.text: log of signing bonus over slot (rounds 11 and later: over 125,000 dollars)

lv_dev.note: development frame, spent, not a claim

vm_dev.note: development frame, spent, not a claim
